platforms.scope: Installation and upgrade; individual runtime checks carry separate evidence.
Linux environment required; clean-machine acceptance pending.

capabilities.title: New OCI account
capabilities.summary: Inspect prerequisites, save initial access choices and prepare a named local target without replacing your app.
prerequisites: A reviewed kit checkout or project-local installation; before installation use the checkout command in the guide
limitations: No cloud requests or automatic account activation, human enrollment or IAM grants.
Onboarding configuration preserves other selections and refuses region or profile changes for bound resources.
Local inspection is not token validity, permission, capacity or deployment evidence.

capabilities.title: Prepare deployment inputs
capabilities.summary: Reuse selected resources and generate reviewed private deployment variables and backend configuration.
prerequisites: Reviewed infrastructure and private nonsecret application choices
limitations: Local configuration only; runtime IAM, image publication and each cloud operation remain separately reviewed.
Existing selections and automatic Terraform inputs are never overwritten.

capabilities.title: Well-Architected evidence
capabilities.summary: Review current evidence and remaining controls across the five OCI Well-Architected pillars.
prerequisites: Existing private reports for observed controls
limitations: Read-only projection of local reports, not certification or authenticated proof.
Unknown IAM, stale observations and missing recovery evidence remain incomplete.

capabilities.title: Your launch acceptance map
capabilities.summary: See the next requirement for a new app or hosting-first migration without confusing local preparation with live acceptance.
limitations: Missing hosted sign-in, persistence, isolated restore and rollback evidence cannot become a passing journey.
Restricted harness, ordinary agent and live OCI evidence remain separate.

capabilities.title: Continue the right environment
capabilities.summary: Inspect your existing project and select one next action.
limitations: Progress is not approval or live verification.

capabilities.title: Package your application
capabilities.summary: Review Next.js, FastAPI or Docker packaging without replacing your app.
prerequisites: Docker with Buildx for generated builds; reviewed Skopeo v2s2 layout
limitations: Container success does not establish migration compatibility.

capabilities.title: Connect OCI prerequisites
capabilities.summary: Reuse an approved foundation or prepare a scoped creation plan.
limitations: No automatic tenancy-wide grants or certificate private keys in state.
Output handoff is owner-supplied configuration; live IAM and resource acceptance remain required.

capabilities.title: Understand a running application
capabilities.summary: Collect bounded cloud observations and render a private operating report.
limitations: Missing permissions and delayed costs remain unknown.
Service-contract and refusal tests are local; live workload readback acceptance is pending.

capabilities.title: Update with a recovery path
capabilities.summary: Link the tested image, observed target and prior accepted revision.
prerequisites: Current bound deployment and behavior evidence
limitations: Rollback needs new exact cloud plans; a single-instance update may interrupt service.

capabilities.title: Add durable background work
capabilities.summary: An optional customer-request example with private files, jobs and webhooks.
limitations: Native scheduling remains experimental until its exact cloud path is accepted.
PostgreSQL/HTTP and local containers exercised; OCI Queue and IAM acceptance are pending.

capabilities.title: Share a safe support summary
capabilities.summary: Preview versions, safe error codes and evidence ages before sharing.
limitations: Allowlisted summary only; never automatically uploads.

capabilities.title: Test and operate your app
capabilities.summary: Plan customer-facing tests, check a production candidate and inspect reliability in a named environment.
prerequisites: Named rehearsal environment for planning; separate production environment and exact saved plan for promotion.
limitations: Agent summaries and local drills do not authorize production.
Live monitoring, hosted CI and OCI deployment require separate setup and acceptance.

capabilities.title: Launch your own Next.js app
capabilities.summary: Prepare a founder-owned Next.js repository and inspect its rehearsal evidence for production promotion.
prerequisites: Named web-container build environment and a Next.js application
Existing tests, identity and data providers
limitations: Hosted sign-in, isolation, rollback and an independently operated verifier require a live rehearsal.

capabilities.title: Preview launch costs
capabilities.summary: Model 24 hours and 30 days of operation and review retained resources after cleanup.
prerequisites: Reviewed web-container footprint and dated rates
limitations: Totals can be incomplete. Delayed or inaccessible billing evidence stays unknown.

capabilities.title: Try the app with a customer
capabilities.summary: Prepare a private tester handoff, record a de-identified observation and review access revocation.
prerequisites: Named rehearsal, current image readback and externally enforced tester access
limitations: The owner operates the identity provider and verifies session revocation. No messages are sent.

versions.compatibility: Existing v0.5/v0.6 commands and records; reviewed local upgrade with private backups.
